# Jeweller Studio

> Jeweller Studio is a branding and marketing studio that works only with jewellers. It helps jewellery brands with digital marketing, branding, AI jewellery photoshoots and reels, packaging, commercial printing, exhibition and retail branding, gifting, and websites. Founded by Jigar Shah (Founder) and Nikita Butani (Co-founder), with Neet Shah as Digital Consultant. Address: Discovery Complex, Dattapada, Borivali East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400066. Contact: WhatsApp +91 90298 72736.

Notes: Service pages describe what we offer and how we work. Pricing and timelines are agreed per project. We do not guarantee specific business results.

## Digital Marketing
- [Digital Marketing overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/): Digital marketing for jewellery brands: social media management, reels, influencer marketing, Meta Ads, YouTube and WhatsApp marketing, and lead campaigns.
- [Social Media Management](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/social-media-management/): Monthly planning, design and posting across your social pages, handled by one team.
- [Instagram Management](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/instagram-management/): Posts, reels and stories managed for the platform where jewellery gets discovered.
- [Facebook Management](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/facebook-management/): Page updates and posts that keep local customers informed and engaged.
- [Social Media Strategy](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/social-media-strategy/): A clear plan for what to post, where and why, built around your customers.
- [Monthly Content Planning](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/monthly-content-planning/): A month-by-month calendar around collections, festivals and the wedding season.
- [Social Media Post Designing](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/social-media-post-designing/): Branded posts and carousels for collections, offers and announcements.
- [Instagram Story Designing](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/instagram-story-designing/): Story designs for launches, offers, greetings and daily updates.
- [Instagram Reels Creation](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/instagram-reels-creation/): Short videos that show detail, sparkle and craftsmanship.
- [Festival & Occasion Creatives](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/festival-and-occasion-creatives/): Greetings and offer creatives ready before each festival and occasion.
- [Influencer Marketing](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/influencer-marketing/): Plan and run campaigns with creators who suit your jewellery and audience.
- [Influencer Collaborations](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/influencer-collaborations/): Find and work with individual creators on shoots, reviews and features.
- [Paid Advertising – Meta Ads](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/paid-advertising-meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns set up to reach the right audience.
- [YouTube Marketing](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/youtube-marketing/): Video content and channel support to grow your presence on YouTube.
- [WhatsApp Marketing](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/whatsapp-marketing/): Catalogue sharing and customer messaging through WhatsApp.
- [Lead Generation Campaigns](https://jewellerstudio.com/digital-marketing/lead-generation-campaigns/): Campaigns designed to bring in enquiries from people ready to buy.

## Branding
- [Branding overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/): Jewellery branding services: brand strategy, logo design, naming, positioning, brand guidelines, storytelling, rebranding and catalogue design for jewellers.
- [Brand Strategy](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/brand-strategy/): The direction behind your brand: who you serve, what you stand for and how you will grow.
- [Creative Design](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/creative-design/): Design work across your brand materials, kept consistent with your identity.
- [Brand Identity Development](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/brand-identity-development/): Logo, colours, typography and style that make your brand recognisable.
- [Logo Designing](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/logo-designing/): A distinctive logo that works on tags, boxes, signboards and screens.
- [Brand Guidelines](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/brand-guidelines/): A rulebook that keeps your brand consistent for every team and vendor.
- [Brand Naming](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/brand-naming/): Names for new jewellery brands that are easy to say and remember.
- [Brand Positioning](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/brand-positioning/): Where your brand sits in the market and why customers should choose it.
- [Tagline & Slogan Creation](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/tagline-and-slogan-creation/): Short lines that sum up your brand in a few words.
- [Brand Rebranding](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/brand-rebranding/): A refreshed identity for brands that have outgrown their old look.
- [Jewellery Collection Naming](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/jewellery-collection-naming/): Memorable names and themes for new collections.
- [Campaign Concept Development](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/campaign-concept-development/): Big ideas for launches, festivals and seasonal campaigns.
- [Luxury Brand Identity](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/luxury-brand-identity/): Refined brand identities for premium and high jewellery.
- [Visual Identity System](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/visual-identity-system/): A complete set of visual rules, from colour and type to layouts and icons.
- [Brand Storytelling](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/brand-storytelling/): Your heritage, craft and values told in a way customers remember.
- [Corporate Profile Design](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/corporate-profile-design/): A company profile that presents your business to buyers and partners.
- [Catalogue Designing](https://jewellerstudio.com/branding/catalogue-designing/): Catalogue layouts that show your designs clearly and sell them well.

## AI Jewellery Photoshoot
- [AI Jewellery Photoshoot overview](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/): AI jewellery photoshoots: model, bridal, lifestyle, campaign and e-commerce images, plus background replacement and retouching, created from your designs.
- [AI Model Photoshoot](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-model-photoshoot/): Model images of your jewellery, created from your designs without a studio shoot.
- [AI Jewellery Product Photoshoot](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-jewellery-product-photoshoot/): Clean, detailed product images for catalogues, websites and marketplaces.
- [AI Bridal Photoshoot](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-bridal-photoshoot/): Bridal looks and sets styled on brides for wedding collections.
- [AI Lifestyle Photoshoot](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-lifestyle-photoshoot/): Everyday and occasion settings that show how your jewellery is worn.
- [AI International Model Shoot](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-international-model-shoot/): Models with international looks for brands with global audiences.
- [AI Campaign Photoshoot](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-campaign-photoshoot/): Concept-led images for launches, ads and brand campaigns.
- [AI Background Replacement](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-background-replacement/): Swap cluttered backgrounds for clean, branded or styled scenes.
- [AI Jewellery Retouching](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-jewellery-retouching/): Polish existing photos: cleaner metal, sharper stones and tidy edges.
- [AI Product Enhancement](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-product-enhancement/): Improve lighting, colour and detail in the photos you already have.
- [AI E-commerce Photography](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-e-commerce-photography/): Consistent product images made for online stores and listings.
- [AI Festival Campaign Shoot](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-festival-campaign-shoot/): Festive imagery for Diwali, Dhanteras and wedding season campaigns.
- [AI Collection Launch Shoot](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-collection-launch-shoot/): A full set of images for launching a new collection.
- [AI Jewellery Poster Creation](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-photoshoot/ai-jewellery-poster-creation/): Posters and banners for showrooms, ads and social media.

- [Logo Animation](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-reels/logo-animation/): An animated logo for videos, reels and screens.
- [Product Explainer Videos](https://jewellerstudio.com/ai-jewellery-reels/product-explainer-videos/): Videos that explain materials, care or a product's features.

- [Bangle Boxes](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/bangle-boxes/): Boxes made to hold bangles and kadas safely.
- [Ring Boxes](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/ring-boxes/): Compact boxes that make a ring feel special.
- [Earring Boxes](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/earring-boxes/): Boxes for studs, jhumkas and drop earrings.
- [Pendant Boxes](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/pendant-boxes/): Small, neat boxes for pendants and chains.
- [Jewellery Pouches](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/jewellery-pouches/): Soft pouches for storing and gifting jewellery.
- [Jewellery Display Trays](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/jewellery-display-trays/): Trays that show your jewellery neatly on the counter.
- [Luxury Gift Boxes](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/luxury-gift-boxes/): Premium boxes for gifts and special occasions.
- [Corporate Gifting Boxes](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/corporate-gifting-boxes/): Branded boxes for client and corporate gifts.
- [Custom Rigid Boxes](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/custom-rigid-boxes/): Sturdy boxes made to your size and design.
- [Magnetic Closure Boxes](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/magnetic-closure-boxes/): Rigid boxes that close neatly with a magnet.
- [Jewellery Carry Bags](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/jewellery-carry-bags/): Branded bags that carry your name out of the store.
- [Shipping Boxes](https://jewellerstudio.com/packaging/shipping-boxes/): Protective outer boxes for sending jewellery safely.

- [Product Catalogues](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/product-catalogues/): Printed catalogues that show your designs at their best.
- [Brochures](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/brochures/): Brochures for collections, services and exhibitions.
- [Jewellery Certificates](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/jewellery-certificates/): Certificates that present your pieces with authority.
- [Warranty Cards](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/warranty-cards/): Warranty and care cards to include with every sale.
- [Jewellery Tags](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/jewellery-tags/): Tags that carry your brand and product details.
- [Price Tags](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/price-tags/): Clear price tags that suit your counter and brand.
- [Coin Cards](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/coin-cards/): Display cards for gold and silver coins.
- [Tent Cards](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/tent-cards/): Counter cards for offers and announcements.
- [Invitation Cards](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/invitation-cards/): Invitations for launches, events and festive occasions.
- [Stickers & Labels](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/stickers-and-labels/): Stickers and labels for boxes, bags and products.
- [Corporate Stationery](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/corporate-stationery/): A matching set of stationery for your business.
- [Gold & Silver Foil](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/gold-and-silver-foil/): Metallic foil finishes that add a premium shine to print.
- [Spot UV Printing](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/spot-uv-printing/): Glossy highlights on selected areas of a design.
- [Embossing](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/embossing/): Raised designs that you can feel as well as see.
- [Debossing](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/debossing/): Pressed-in designs for a refined, tactile finish.
- [Textured Printing](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/textured-printing/): Textured finishes that add depth to cards and boxes.
- [Die-Cut Printing](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/die-cut-printing/): Custom shapes and cut-outs for distinctive print pieces.
- [Large Format Printing](https://jewellerstudio.com/commercial-printing/large-format-printing/): Banners, posters and large prints for stores and events.
